label: Backward selection
subgoals: Seed the worklist with the primary outputs
Implement each popped node over its best cut
Push the gate leaves of that cut that are not yet implemented

label: Counting LUTs and duplication
subgoals: Count the implemented nodes as the LUT count
List the gates each LUT absorbs between its cut and its root
Count gates absorbed by two or more LUTs as duplicated

label: Depth of the selected cover
subgoals: Compute each LUT's depth from its LUT inputs
Read the network depth as the largest output label
Separate the depth decision from the area decision
